label: F-f79096

findings.note: Plan D3 decides the member as `string QuotaKeyOf(string model)` and D4 decides string `key`/`source` fields; the typed-value request goes against the spec's own design.

QuotaCooldowns.cs:187 does accept any key, source or far-future untilUtc without checking them, but that takes a hand-edited file, the plan's fail-open contract covers only torn or unparseable files, and the card shows the standing entry, so the park is not silent.

QuotaRound.cs:24-30 does await each key in turn, but only agy keys with a table entry probe (AntigravityRuntime.cs:174-176), so this happens only when several agy groups are spent in the same round, and the plan's 'one agy child per spent key, bounded at 30 s' does not ask for parallel probes.

Plan D8 says the Cooldown member is built in ProbeAsync from `Standing(RuntimeFor(provider)?.QuotaKeyOf(provider.Model), now)`, so the code does what the plan says, and the divergence described is only a hypothetical future one.
Plan D4 says the file is 'read on every `CanRun`, no cache (it is under 16 KiB for ever, §8)', and §8 repeats it; the finding asks for what the plan rejected.

Plan D3 specifies the family as 'the id minus its trailing -low / -medium / -high' with an explicit measured table and an `antigravity/?<model>` fallback by design, and the plan-gate record rejects pattern-based mapping.

QuotaCooldowns.cs:187 dereferences `e.Key` on a null array element, and the NullReferenceException is not in ReadFile's catch filter (JsonException/IOException/UnauthorizedAccessException), so it escapes Standing into CanRun, which breaks the plan's fail-open contract; the next commit, ddd12695, fixed exactly this.

ProcessLauncher.cs:570 sets `Cancelled` only when the caller's token fired, and AgyQuotaProbe.ReadAsync passes the round's own `ct` and calls `ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()` before Judged, so the filter's condition is always true when it matters; AfterRoundAsync also catches OperationCanceledException regardless.
This repeats index 4; plan D4 and §8 explicitly choose a fresh read on every decision with no cache, because the file is tiny and several processes share it.
AgyError.cs:31 runs only on a failed launch's stderr, which the launcher already bounds (BoundedText); allocating for a split on that error path is negligible micro-optimisation.
CooldownWords.TimeLeft's `Math.Max(1, …)` is deliberate ('never told a quota is back before it is'), and Sentence is only reached for an entry that Standing returned with `UntilUtc > now`.

summary: Only the null-element crash (index 6) is a clear, important defect, and the team fixed it in the next commit; the serial probes and missing entry validation are minor real points. The rest either asks for what the plan explicitly decided against (no cache, string keys, suffix-stripped family table, RuntimeFor in ProbeAsync) or misreads the code (the cancellation filter, TimeLeft), so the set is mostly noise.
